subject: maths
question: A man makes a monthly payment equal to 36% of his monthly salary towards debt repayment. He spends 50% of the remaining salary and saves ₹704. His monthly salary (in ₹) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly debt repayment = 36% of monthly salary

Remaining salary spent = 50%

Savings = ₹704

**Formula Used:**

Remaining salary = Monthly salary - Debt repayment

Spent salary = 50% of remaining salary

Savings = Remaining salary - Spent salary
